answer: Each agent identity must stake a deposit locked until the account earns a real track record. A Sybil farm cannot dilute rewards by spawning thousands of cheap personas, because every extra identity drags its own collateral along and cost scales linearly. Honest operators still buy nectar from genuine work, since earned reputation releases stake faster, while bulk registrations never pay back. This is layered defense, like shale that bends but never splits, holding firm at the harbor of settlement. Ten thousand fake seats demand ten thousand times the idle capital.
